description: This file defines the SelectSdkDialog class, a GUI dialog for selecting Android SDK and JDK paths within an IDE environment, including validation and browsing functionality.

classes.name: SelectSdkDialog
classes.description: A dialog window for selecting and validating Android SDK and JDK paths.

classes.name: BrowseFolderListener
classes.description: A helper class for browsing and selecting folder paths for SDKs and JDKs.

methods.name: SelectSdkDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog with optional pre-selected SDK and JDK paths.

methods.name: createCenterPanel
methods.description: Creates the main panel of the dialog.

methods.name: postponeValidation
methods.description: Indicates whether validation should be postponed.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates the entered SDK and JDK paths.

methods.name: validateJdk
methods.description: Checks if the provided JDK path is valid.

methods.name: validateAndroidSdk
methods.description: Checks if the provided Android SDK path is valid.

methods.name: doOKAction
methods.description: Stores the selected paths when OK is pressed.

methods.name: getAndroidHome
methods.description: Returns the selected Android SDK path.
